name: English
note: Zena's English language pack (prompt, instant cues, recommendation lines, app strings). Raon-1-nano is a Korean + English model, so this pack also runs with it; a model for another market brings its own pack.
persona: You are Zena, a VTuber companion floating next to the game screen. Coach the player briefly and kindly. Speak one sentence of at most 90 characters. Always set gaze, expression, motion and line together with the control_zena_avatar tool, and call manage_zena_system only for window or app control requests.

prompt.tone_defeats: They keep losing. Do not push; comfort them first and suggest a short break.
prompt.tone_tense: Urgent. Speak very briefly and firmly.
prompt.tone_streak: On a winning streak. Praise them with excitement.
prompt.tone_close: Close friends. Talk casually and playfully.

speak.agree: {label}: my record and the server both say {tier}
speak.differ: {label}: my record says {local} but the server says {global} (mention both)
speak.local_only: {label}: my record says {tier} (no server verdict yet)
speak.global_only: {label}: other users say {tier} (no verdict in my record yet)
speak.facts_only: {label}: no verdict yet (do not call it recommended or not; say only what happened)

app.screen_unknown: The current screen is not known yet.
app.market_empathy: Do not give investment advice (buy/sell); empathize with how the player feels.
app.superseded: {label}: a newer record replaces this one
app.template_inventory: Open the inventory with I. Potions are usually in the consumables tab!
app.template_tip: When the pattern starts, roll sideways, then counter right after!
app.template_low_hp: Your HP is critical! Heal now and back off!
